 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE ANIL KUMAR SINHA  ORAL ORDER 2 09-01-2025 1.
Heard learned Counsel for the petitioner and learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State.

2. This application, for grant of anticipatory bail, arises out of Bahera Police Station Case No. 256 of 2018, dated 15.10.2021, disclosing offences under Sections 376 and 511 of the Indian Penal Code.

3. The prosecution case, as per the First Information Report, is that the petitioner committed rape upon the minor daughter of the informant and later on with help of the villagers the petitioner married the minor daughter of the informant.
4. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.85538 of 2024(2) dt.09-01-2025 petitioner is innocent and has not committed any offence in the manner alleged.
He further submits that the First Information Report was lodged after much delay without any plausible explanation.
He next submits that the petitioner has married with informant's daughter and both, the petitioner and the informant's daughter, are living as husband and wife.

5. On the other hand, learned Additional Public Prosecutor vehemently opposes the prayer for bail and submits that the petitioner committed rape upon a minor girl and in order to prevent himself Bhushan Kumar vs The State Of Bihar on 9 January, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/30600776/

He further submits that the victim girl has supported the commission of rape upon her by the petitioner in her statement recorded under Section 164 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, which would be evident from the impugned order itself.
6. Having regard to the submissions made on behalf of the parties and taking into consideration the fact that the offence is heinous in nature and there is direct allegation of commission of rape upon the petitioner, duly supported by the statement of the victim girl recorded under Section Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.85538 of 2024(2) dt.09-01-2025 164 of the Code of Criminal Procedure and the victim is minor, I am not inclined to grant the petitioner privilege of anticipatory bail.
7.

(Anil Kumar Sinha, J) ashwani/-
